notes.title: URBAN TRIAL TRICKY - Coming Soon
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5079574/c7de60c49f6a1e6f208b7ecc253055ff0902cda5.png

Hungry for more Urban Trial experience?
Urban Trial Tricky is coming to town! A light-hearted game mixing tricks, platforming, and racing. Easy gameplay, yet deep and rewarding. Set in a cartoon-style city, the game features a dynamic tricks system that enables players to finesse the most exciting moves and combos on a motorbike. 3 modes, over 30 levels, and a vast amount of outstanding customization options make Urban Trial Tricky infinite and varied experience. And all of this in smooth 60 FPS!

Urban Trial Tricky is coming soon to the Nintendo Switch platform.

ABOUT THE GAME:

Become a crazy trickster! 
Grab your seat and pull off the most savage tricks and combos on your motorbike. Ride freely, spin around in the air, go back and forth and let yourself be carried away by the fun, fast-paced gameplay, colorful visuals, and smooth controls. 

Get stylish!
Learn new freestyle, breakdance, and FMX moves to fit your own style. Unlock crazy costumes and customize your motorbike at will.

Push yourself and others to greatness!
Complete challenges and master countless outstanding maneuvers and tricks to rule the leaderboards.

KEY FEATURES:

1. Exciting light-hearted casual gameplay
2. Crazy mix of tricks, platforming, and racing
3. Killer tricks to combine in countless combos
4. Super-smooth experience in 60 FPS
5. 3 single-player modes
6. Over 30 levels + side challenges
7. Savage customization options
8. Leaderboards to rule
9. Infinite gameplay
10. More freedom, more fun. Riding in both directions.

Stay tuned for more and visit http://urbantrialtricky.com/

notes.title: Urban Trial Playground comes to Steam!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33040674/7f3449127a7cc3621b6312e15b620aca15a123eb.jpg

Hi bikers, 
we have a surprise for you!

Urban Trial Playground is coming straight to PC after successful Nintendo Switch version.
Crazy muti-combos, mix of tricks and bike stunts in the whole new setting awaits for you!

Add to wishlist now! And don't miss any of our upcoming info!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/988240/Urban_Trial_Playground/

What can you expect from UTP?


 Levels designed to perform combos and motorcycle stunts (and of course to climb the leaderboards with crazy multi-combo-scores)  
 Enhanced graphics. Best visuals compared to Nintendo Switch version. (Without Instagram filters – we promise)
 2 DLC packs  – ‘Challenges pack” –  which contains additional challenges to the game and „Even MORE style pack” (skins for the rider and the motorcycle) implemented in the base version of the game (and completely free)
 Multiplayer, which offers local split-screen playthrough (cause playing with you buddy is the best thing there is)
 Tuning of the motorbike (Your roaring machine has help you with scoring points? Grab a new engine!)
 Character customization (Even though if your stylish clothes does not guarantee additional point on leaderboards, it’s always worth to maintain your swag level high).


Share your thoughts with us, visit our community hub and our social media channels!

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 has been released. Please see to the list of changes:
notes.content:
We have added additional video settings in Main Menu/  Help & Options/  Video.  Try with different settings for optimal quality/performance.  Please note that this version overrides your previous settings, so you may want to change them to take advantage of your PC performance.
Xbox 360 pad (or compatible) has been set as primary controller. If you have more than one controller and one of them is Xbox controller, only this one will work. If you want to play with another controller, please unplug the Xbox 360 controller.
When running the game on laptop with 2 video cards, please make sure that dedicated card is on while running the game. You can switch on your dedicated video card in video card's driver panel.
